newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-RAMS HIRE FORMER OAKLAND HEAD COACH MIKE WHITE AS ASSISTANT.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-RAMS HIRE FORMER OAKLAND HEAD COACH MIKE WHITE AS ASSISTANT.

text.p: New St Louis Rams coach Dick Vermeil continued to fill his staff with sexagenarian former head coaches Monday by hiring Mike White as his assistant head coach and tight ends coach.
The 61-year-old White was fired from his post as Oakland head coach on Christmas Eve after guiding the Raiders to a 7-9 record last season.
White compiled a 15-17 record in two seasons as Oakland's head coach. He previously served as quarterbacks coach for the Raiders from 1990-92 and was offensive line coach the following two seasons.
Vermeil, the former Philadelphia Eagles head coach, agreed to take the top spot with the Rams last month after 14 years out of the National Football League.

The 60-year-old Vermeil has already named 63-year-old Jim Hanifan, a former head coach of the St Louis Cardinals, as his offensive line coach; 65-year-old Bud Carson, a former head coach of the Cleveland Browns, as his defensive coordinator; and 68-year-old Dick Coury, a former head coach in the defunct United States Football League, as his receivers coach.
